Source I ‘Most people from 1945 onwards would have expected nuclear weapons to be used in warfare reasonably soon after that, yet almost 60 years of Cold War passed without the use of nuclear weapons. If it hadn’t been for the lessons both the East and the West learned from Hiroshima, I don’t think that would have happened.’
ODD ARNE WESTAD Professor of US-Asia Relations, Harvard University
Extract from Have the ashes of Hiroshima taught the world anything?
by INGRID PIPER Courtesy of Professor Odd Arne Westad
